claims: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, D.C. runs from March 20 to April 12.
The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival's peak bloom occurs on March 26.
The Yoshino trees at the Tidal Basin are currently in full, puffy white bloom.
The National Park Service confirmed peak bloom on March 26, 2026.
Prime viewing spots include the Tidal Basin, East Potomac Park, and the National Arboretum.
Other locations include East Potomac Park, The Wharf, and the U.S. National Arboretum.
The National Cherry Blossom Festival Parade is held during the festival period.
According to WTOP, the flowers are expected to remain on the trees for several days, depending on weather conditions.
